chapters.label: The Euros, live
chapters.text: Gelsenkirchen, 2024. England play Serbia at the Euros. Early on, Marc Guéhi wins a tackle against the big striker Dušan Vlahović. Moments later, Vlahović shoots... blocked by Guéhi!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Guéhi reads it early. He steps across into the shot, stays on his feet and keeps his body facing the ball. Bang, it hits him and bounces away!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. When a striker shoots, don't dive in. Stay on your feet, get in the way, and block the shot with your body facing the ball!
